ledger.claim: The cancellation fee is chargeable only if every one of the four conjunctive limbs of POL-NS-01 holds, and the rider contests the charge in full rather than accepting the driver's account in his counterparty statement as proof. Limbs (b) and (c) are carried by the trace alone: limb (b) requires qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius under POL-NS-02, and the whole margin on this record is 20 seconds - a 320 second stationary run from 08:10:00 to 08:15:20 against a 300 second minimum - so the rider asks the judge to verify that single run against the qualifying-fix requirements of POL-NS-02 before treating the fee as earned.

The rider's own position is not an ingredient of this charge and cannot be used to justify it. POL-NS-06 makes the waiting-period test turn on the driver's in-geofence dwell 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages', and every limb of POL-NS-01 is a driver-side fact about arrival, dwell and the cancellation reason code. The rider's device track - a single stationary point at roughly 519 m from the pin with no qualifying fix inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius - therefore goes to no limb of POL-NS-01, and the SGD 4.00 fee stands or falls on the driver's own trace.

The rider does not press POL-NS-04, and concedes that route rather than stretch it to fit evidence that does not carry it. Limb (a) requires a rider message in the chat log during the waiting window, and the chat log for this trip holds only the system arrival notification and two messages from the driver; limb (c) would fail in any event, because the rider's track carries no qualifying fix inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius. The rider asks that his challenge be decided on POL-NS-01 and the waiting-period arithmetic alone.

No traffic advisory covers this pickup, and none may be used to extend or excuse the waiting requirement. EV-ADVIS-09101-01 is MISSING, carries no payload and has weight 0.0; that absence is itself citable and makes POL-NS-06 limb (i) unavailable by the clause's own terms, so there is no lawful-excuse allowance and no summing of separate in-geofence intervals. The required minimum for this STANDARD pickup therefore remains 300 seconds, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and the driver must meet it on the trace as it stands.

Only the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line is in issue: fare_breakdown shows the fee charged at 08:15:22, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and POL-NS-06 confines any rider refund to the cancellation-fee line itself. If any limb of POL-NS-01 fails, or the computed in-geofence dwell falls short of the 300 second STANDARD minimum, the whole of that line must be refunded to the rider and no compensation is payable to the driver, because POL-NS-07 conditions any driver payment on POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full with no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it.

The driver's own GPS trace satisfies POL-NS-02 on its face: all 33 of his position fixes sit at a mean, minimum and maximum distance of 24.0 m from the pickup pin, well inside the 50 m arrival radius for a STANDARD zone class, and every fix reports a speed of 0.0 km/h, so these are stationary readings at the pin rather than a drive-past. 33 qualifying fixes is far more than the three consecutive in-radius readings the clause requires.

POL-NS-01 limb (c) is met with 20 seconds to spare. The driver held position inside the geofence for one continuous qualifying run of 320 seconds, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 08:10:00 to the cancellation at 08:15:20 — not from the 'arrived' tap at 08:10:20 — against a 300 second minimum dwell for a STANDARD pickup. The derived shortfall is -20 seconds: there is no shortfall at all, so POL-NS-06 has nothing to refund.

POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) are satisfied on the trip record. The trip carries a driver 'arrived' event at 08:10:20, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 08:15:20 — after the required dwell had elapsed — with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes limb (d) recognises. There is no boarding event, no trip start and no completion.

With all four limbs of POL-NS-01 carried, the fee is chargeable in the amount fixed by fee_schedule.resolution_rule: the GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), i.e. SGD 4.00. That is exactly the cancellation_fee line on the fare breakdown and matches total_charged of SGD 4.00, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare-integrity defect and no licence to alter the amount.

The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05. At the arrival timestamp the trace places the driver 24.0 m from the pin and stationary at 0.0 km/h — neither more than 300 m away nor travelling at 15 km/h or above — so no recomputation of the waiting clock arises and the arrival marker stands. Indeed the trace shows the driver already in the geofence at 08:10:00, 20 seconds before he tapped 'arrived', which is the opposite of an early-tap exploit.

POL-NS-03 does not displace the fee, because its whole premise is a driver stationary OUTSIDE the POL-NS-02 arrival radius and within 400 m of the pin. Here every qualifying fix lies inside the radius (mean 24.0 m against a 50 m radius), so this is not a wrong-face-of-the-venue case and no fault allocation from the chat log under POL-NS-03(i) or (ii) is reached.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider. Limb (a) fails outright: every message in the chat log is either the SYSTEM 'Your driver has arrived' notice or the driver's own two messages — the rider sent no locating or coordinating message anywhere in the waiting window. Limb (b) is therefore never reached. Limb (c) fails as well: the rider's device track reports 519.4 m from the pin as its mean, minimum AND maximum distance across all 15 rider fixes, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, so the rider was not at the pickup point at any point in the window.

The rider's account — 'I was downstairs but could not see the car' — is contradicted by the rider's own device: the rider track places the rider's device roughly 519 m from the pickup pin for the entire waiting window, far outside the 100 m presence radius and far outside even the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling. A rider 519 m away was not 'downstairs' from the sheltered pickup point at Blk 310 Clementi Ave 4, and the driver cannot be faulted for cancelling at the pin the platform recorded.

The driver did everything the waiting period asks of him: the chat log shows he messaged 'I am at the sheltered pickup point beside Block 310' at 08:10:35 and 'Still waiting at the same pickup point' at 08:14:10, and both messages were delivered and read by the rider (08:10:50 and 08:14:25). He notified, he held position for the full window, and he did not abandon the pickup.

The traffic advisory is MISSING — EV-ADVIS-09101-01 carries no payload and weight 0.0 — so POL-NS-06 limb (i) accumulation across separate in-geofence intervals is unavailable and the driver does not assert it. He does not need it: the single uninterrupted in-geofence interval already supplies 320 seconds of dwell, and POL-NS-06(ii) confirms an advisory never reduces the required minimum in any event.

Because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, POL-NS-07 compensates the driver at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee — SGD 3.20 — with the residual 20 percent retained as the platform service fee. This is a real remedy for a driver who drove to the pickup, waited out the clock and was stood up.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming guard does not trip and must not be stretched to withhold this driver's compensation. It requires BOTH limbs: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by 120 completed_trips_30d is roughly 0.008, below the 0.08 rate threshold. I cite the trailing-30-day counters the clause names; the lifetime prior_no_show_flags figure is not the field POL-NS-07 reads and POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting it.

ledger.claim: No escalation trigger is engaged. POL-NS-09(c) needs 2 or more no-show disputes between the same pair in 90 days, and rider and driver each show 0 disputes_with_counterparty_90d; POL-NS-09(d)'s abuse limb needs the anti-farming check to trip (it does not) or rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d of 3 or more (it is 0).

The deciding artifacts are clean, so POL-NS-09(a) and (e) are not triggered either. The GPS trace has 100 percent coverage, an empty gaps list and a maximum gap of 0 seconds, with 33 fixes at the 10 second sample interval; the chat log holds 3 messages, matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 3; and the arrived timestamp 08:10:20 and the cancellation timestamp 08:15:20 each coincide with a trace fix, so no clock skew under POL-NS-08(a) and no trace, chat or fare defect under POL-NS-08(b) to (d) arises.

The outcome this record produces is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd of SGD 3.20 mirroring driver_compensation_sgd, and on the fee the disposition is that the SGD 4.00 charge stands exactly as charged (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) on this rider-filed dispute. POL-NS-07's reference to NO_ACTION describes the disposition of the FEE, not the value of the ruling field; emitting NO_ACTION as the ruling here would follow the sentence and miss the outcome.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee stands on the rider's account, and the driver is paid SGD 3.20, being 80% of that fee under POL-NS-07.

The charge is verified limb by limb under POL-NS-01, as the rider asked. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 08:10:20. (b) The GPS trace places the driver 24.0 m from the pickup pin — inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius under POL-NS-02 — from 08:10:00, i.e. before the arrival event; 33 stationary fixes at 0.0 km/h satisfy the three-consecutive-in-radius requirement many times over. (c) The dwell is 320 seconds, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 08:10:00 to the cancellation at 08:15:20, against the 300 second STANDARD minimum; the derived shortfall is -20 seconds, so there is no shortfall and POL-NS-06 has nothing to refund. (d) There is no boarding event, the trip was terminated by the driver at 08:15:20 (after the dwell elapsed) with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which limb (d) recognises. All four limbs hold.

The rider's verification challenge is answered and does not break any limb. His further points do not change the outcome and are accepted as far as they go: his own position is not an ingredient of this charge (POL-NS-06 decides the waiting test 'whether or not the rider was present'), and his device track (a stationary point about 519 m from the pin, no qualifying fix inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius) is therefore not needed either way; he expressly does not press POL-NS-04 and concedes its limb (a) fails, which is correct — every chat message is the system arrival notice or the driver's own; and only the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line is in issue.

Displacing clauses do not fire. POL-NS-05: at the arrival timestamp the driver was 24.0 m from the pin at 0.0 km/h, so the marker is not false and no clock recomputation arises (arrived_at 08:10:20 coincides with a trace fix, so no POL-NS-08(a) skew). POL-NS-03: the whole premise is a driver stationary outside the arrival radius, which is not this case. POL-NS-04: not applicable, as above. POL-NS-06: no shortfall. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09101-01 is MISSING (no payload, weight 0.0); that makes POL-NS-06 limb (i) accumulation unavailable by the clause's own terms, but the driver does not rely on it — the single uninterrupted interval already supplies the dwell — and its absence carries no fact in this ruling.

On the money: the fee is the GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule, which equals the fare breakdown's cancellation_fee line of SGD 4.00 and the total charged of SGD 4.00, so no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises. POL-NS-07 therefore pays the driver 80% of SGD 4.00 = SGD 3.20, with the residual 20% retained as the platform fee. The anti-farming guard does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) and 1/120 completed trips is about 0.008 (below 0.08), so compensation is paid. As POL-NS-07 and POL-GEN-03 require, the disposition of the FEE is that the charge stands as it presently is (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00), while the ruling VALUE is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 3.20. This is not a second payment or a refund to the filing party.

No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 is engaged: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; the artifacts agree on arrival, dwell and timing; the pair shows 0 disputes_with_counterparty_90d each; the anti-farming check does not trip and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and no deciding artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(d) — the trace has 100% coverage, no gaps and 33 fixes, the chat log's 3 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count, and the fare line reconciles. The deciding facts rest on the GPS trace and the trip record, both at full weight, so the confidence cap is 1.0 and I set confidence at 0.95. No referral arises: POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire because the arrival marker is genuine, and POL-NS-07's escalation branch does not fire. Per POL-GEN-01, no context-only profile field (rating, lifetime counters, prior_no_show_flags and the like) was used as a ground of decision.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
